summary:
Only applicable if pipes are enabled for the build, which they are not by the default configuration.
From Debian: Only an issue when configured with --enable-pipes. Enabling pipes are
a security risk per se and user needs to take precautions accordingly
when enabled.
https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2023-34152
https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/issues/6339#issuecomment-1559698800
